svg.title: The Ethernet II frame
svg.desc: An Ethernet II frame: the destination MAC address (bytes 0 to 5), the source MAC address (6 to 11), the EtherType (12 and 13), then the payload from byte 14. Each 802.1Q VLAN tag inserts 4 bytes before the EtherType, which shifts it and the payload.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
